_comment: Every outside tool the forge drives or hands off to (BUILD 98 Part 1: 'every tool gets a home in the forge, a doctor check, a licence line and a connector op'). Claude Opus, 2026-11-21. A tool is found by the first of its 'paths' that exists (a path starting with a drive letter is absolute; anything else is inside the forge folder; %VAR% is expanded). forge.json -> tools -> <id> -> exe overrides. 'op' names the connector operation that drives it; 'by_hand' says what William does himself. Nothing here names a game.

tools.name: Blender 5.3 (with add-on profiles)
tools.licence: GPL-3.0 (the program; what it makes is ours). Add-ons: docs\BLENDER_ADDONS.md
tools.for: house kit, trees, bakes, retopology, export to Godot, vistas' base renders

tools.name: ComfyUI (the art engine: FLUX.2 klein, TRELLIS.2, Pixal3D)
tools.licence: GPL-3.0 (program); FLUX.2 klein 4B Apache-2.0; TRELLIS.2 MIT

tools.name: Filter Forge 15
tools.licence: William's own licence (commercial use of rendered output allowed)

tools.name: Material Maker
tools.for: seamless materials, every channel (BUILD 87), William's scans made seamless (Part 3)

tools.name: Godot 4.7.2
tools.for: the game; its still mode takes the area pictures

tools.name: Photographic Studio By Bill (raw development, denoise)
tools.licence: GPL-3.0 (William's own; the forge runs it as a separate program, never imports it)
tools.for: raw development for William's R5 textures and scans; colour match to a look profile, depth maps and parallax layers, cut-outs, clean, relight (its docs/CLI.md)

tools.name: RealityScan (photogrammetry)
tools.licence: Free under US$1M a year revenue (Epic); output is ours
tools.install: Epic Games Launcher -> RealityScan (William's Epic account)

tools.name: Effekseer (effects editor) + its Godot 4 plug-in
tools.for: smoke, steam, fire, sparks (Part 6) — first check it loads on Godot 4.7
tools.install: github.com/effekseer/Effekseer releases (MIT): asks William before fetching

tools.name: Topaz Gigapixel
paths: C:\Program Files\Topaz Labs LLC\Topaz Gigapixel AI\Topaz Gigapixel AI.exe
C:\Program Files\Topaz Labs LLC\Topaz Gigapixel\Topaz Gigapixel.exe

tools.name: Adobe Photoshop
